06/22/2024

Almost everyone on the planet searching for a montana wants one with that red body and green/yellow green lid with red veins! Truth be told, almost EVERY single montana clone I've ever grown can do that, but it requires the right environmental conditions. What are those conditions? They are dynamic. So dynamic and complex that Mike Wang doesn't really know all of the details, but for sure, blasting unobstructed full sun all day from sun up till sunset isn't optimal, you probably want some level of filtered light or less hours of direct sunlight in addition to maybe a dozen other factors that will steer this thread off topic so I won't go there (hyperventilates as though I ran out of breath saying that...mentally).

Some updated pics, taken 4/9/26:




Check out the old "folded taco" traps from last season, so you know MW ain't pulling your leg, this is with 100% certainty the same clone#1!
